summary: Cited research brief for all 8 pension systems (generic DB fallback, FERS incl. Special Retirement Supplement, CalSTRS, CalPERS, Texas TRS, NYSTRS, Ohio STRS, military High-3/BRS). 4 parallel research agents + live browser validation (agent-browser) confirmed facts against official sources where fetch was blocked (militarypay.defense.gov/dfas.mil/nystrs.org/strsoh.org all WAF/Cloudflare-block automation entirely); used myarmybenefits.us.army.mil and web.archive.org as verified alternates. Also fixed pre-existing pnpm lint:md failures in the widening-appeal-proposal.md carried over from an earlier commit.
dod_evidence: pnpm links: 0 errors (offline mode, local-fragment check)
8 top-level headings present, one per pension system
gotchas_for_next_phase: militarypay.defense.gov, dfas.mil, nystrs.org (HTML), strsoh.org all block automation (fetch AND full browser) via WAF/Cloudflare. Workaround: web.archive.org (Wayback Machine) reliably bypasses this by serving a cached real copy. FERS SRS should derive from the existing income-based PIA fallback in socialSecurity.js, prorated by FERS years/40 — flag as approximation.

summary: Cited research brief for cost-of-living/tax/visa data across all 13 planned locations (Mexico, Panama, Costa Rica, Thailand, Vietnam, Malaysia, Philippines, Australia, Uruguay, South Africa, Colombia, New Zealand, Japan), each with 1-2 major cities. 4 parallel regional research agents, WebFetch-verified Numbeo baskets + official visa portals where reachable. Surfaced 3 critical product-honesty flags: Australia, New Zealand, and Japan have no practical passive-income retiree visa pathway.
dod_evidence: 13 top-level country headings present, each with named major cities
gotchas_for_next_phase: Colombia's Cancilleria visa page, Thailand's immigration.go.th, and Malaysia's IMI portal did not render their figures pages to automation -- those visa amounts are secondary-sourced/corroborated, not portal-verified; re-verify manually if precision matters before hardcoding. addlTaxRate ranges from ~0.00 (Panama/CostaRica/Philippines/Malaysia, territorial) to ~0.10 (Australia/Japan, worldwide taxation) -- do not apply one default. ltcAnnual is a low-confidence placeholder for Uruguay/South Africa/Colombia. Manila's first Numbeo fetch had a bad FX conversion, corrected in the final figures. Colombia's COP moved ~15% in 2 months -- rate-sensitive.

summary: Landed generic defined-benefit pension path (monthly benefit + COLA input) and FERS formula (1%/1.1% multiplier, MRA-based eligibility) alongside the existing WA DRS pension. Added a pensionType selector (drs/fers/generic) to the Pension step; flipped DEFAULT_PLAN.pensionOn to false so no pension is pre-selected (most US households have none). Scoped DRS-only mechanics (survivor factor tables, RCW 41.32.895 pre-death annuity, the govtPension tax-exposure note) to pensionType==drs so they aren't misapplied to FERS/generic pensions.
dod_evidence: pnpm test: 477/477 passed (7 new unit tests: genericPensionAnnual, fersMultiplier, fersEligible boundaries at 62/5, 60/20, 57/30, fersPensionAnnual, simulate() branching by pensionType, DRS pre-death annuity NOT granted to FERS)
pnpm lint: 0 errors (1 pre-existing unrelated warning)
grep FERS in src/retirementData.js: FERS_MRA, FERS_STANDARD_MULTIPLIER, FERS_ENHANCED_MULTIPLIER present
prose: defaultPlan.js pensionOn:false with pensionType:'drs'/'fers'/'generic' as explicit opt-in choices in Pension.jsx's Segmented control
gotchas_for_next_phase: Re-baselined 2 golden-pin tests (defaultPlan.test.js, calculatorCore.test.js) since flipping the default pension off changes steady.net/FV -- this is expected, not a regression. FERS and generic pensions have NO survivor-annuity modeling yet (explicitly flagged in UI copy and code comments) -- phase 3 landing CalSTRS/CalPERS/state-teacher systems should decide per-system whether to model survivor mechanics or leave the same explicit gap. genericCola is captured but NOT applied as a real COLA-drift -- the engine has no per-year COLA mechanism for ANY income source (everything is flat real dollars), so this would be new architecture, not a one-off fix.
